## Requested change

Describe the exact purpose and file scope.

## MRL classification

- [ ] Every touched asset is classified before transformation.
- [ ] MRL-native product identities and historical paths are preserved.
- [ ] External material keeps its original provenance.

## Authorization and migration

Authorization record: none / record_id
Migration contract: none / record_id
Root approval evidence: none / reference

- [ ] No access, collaborator role, bot execution or silence is treated as authorization.
- [ ] No unapproved deletion, destructive rename, global replacement or license expansion is included.
- [ ] Operating permission is not represented as ownership, authorship, founder status or commercial-right transfer.

## Verification

List commands, results and rollback. A mass change without a root-approved migration contract must not be merged.
